_note: The exercise database. Order matters: within a movement pattern, earlier exercises are preferred when a gym has the equipment for several. 'detectable' = we expect the watch to recognise it from wrist motion. 'rep_profile' names the tuned calibration in RepCounter.swift; 'rep_profile_verified' is true ONLY when that exact movement appears in the MM-Fit validation set, false when the profile is borrowed from a similar movement and is therefore an untested transfer. increment_kg / increment_lb = the smallest weight jump for that exercise in each unit. cues = short form tips for the How to do it screen (have a coach check them before launch).

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
cues: Feet flat, shoulder blades pinched together
Grip just wider than your shoulders
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Press up and slightly back over your shoulders

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Rest the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and kick them up
Feet flat, shoulder blades pinched together
Lower until your elbows are just below the bench
Press up, bringing the dumbbells together at the top

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
cues: Bar on your front shoulders, grip just outside them
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core
Press straight up, moving your head back out of the way
Finish with the bar over the middle of your feet

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Sit tall with your back against the bench
Start with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward
Press up until your arms are nearly straight
Lower slowly back to shoulder height

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cues: Stand tall with a slight bend in your elbows
Raise the dumbbells out to your sides
Stop at shoulder height
Lower slowly, without swinging

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
cues: Stand side-on to the cable, handle in your far hand
Keep a slight bend in your elbow
Raise your arm out to the side, up to shoulder height
Lower slowly against the cable

exercises.name: Cable tricep pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned to your sides
Push the handle down until your arms are straight
Squeeze at the bottom
Let it rise until your forearms are just above parallel

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands
Keep your elbows pointing forward, close to your head
Lower it behind your head
Straighten your arms to lift it back up

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
cues: Thighs locked under the pads, grip wider than your shoulders
Lean back slightly, chest up
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight

exercises.name: Pull-up
cues: Hang with your hands just wider than your shoulders
Pull your shoulder blades down before you bend your arms
Pull until your chin clears the bar
Lower all the way down under control

exercises.name: Barbell row
cues: Hinge forward to about 45 degrees, back flat
Grip just wider than your shoulders
Pull the bar to your lower ribs
Lower it slowly without rounding your back

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: One knee and one hand on the bench, back flat
Let the dumbbell hang straight down
Pull it to your hip, elbow close to your body
Lower until your arm is straight

exercises.name: Seated cable row
cues: Sit tall with your knees slightly bent
Pull the handle to your belly
Squeeze your shoulder blades together
Let your arms straighten without rounding forward

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
cues: Stand tall, elbows at your sides
Curl the dumbbells up, palms facing up
Keep your body still, no swinging
Lower slowly until your arms are straight

exercises.name: Cable curl
cues: Face the cable, elbows at your sides
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders
Keep your elbows still
Lower slowly until your arms are straight

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Stand with the bar at your hips, knees slightly bent
Push your hips back, keeping the bar close to your legs
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, back flat
Drive your hips forward to stand up

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent
Push your hips back, keeping the dumbbells close to your legs
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, back flat
Drive your hips forward to stand up

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
cues: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart
Brace your core, chest up
Sit down between your heels until your thighs are at least parallel
Drive up through your whole foot

exercises.name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell against your chest
Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out
Sit down between your heels, elbows inside your knees
Drive up through your whole foot

exercises.name: Leg press
cues: Feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform
Lower until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees
Keep your lower back on the pad
Press up without locking your knees

exercises.name: Dumbbell calf raise
cues: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, stand tall
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can
Pause at the top
Lower slowly until your heels are below your toes

exercises.name: Bodyweight calf raise
cues: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can
Pause at the top
Lower slowly until your heels touch the floor

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
cues: Hang from the bar with straight arms
Pull your knees up toward your chest
Curl your hips up at the top, don't just swing your legs
Lower slowly without rocking

exercises.name: Cable crunch
cues: Kneel facing the cable, rope held beside your head
Crunch down by rounding your spine, not by pulling with your arms
Bring your elbows toward your thighs
Rise slowly under control

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
cues: Lie on your back, hands by your hips
Keep your legs straight and together
Raise them until they're vertical
Lower slowly, stopping before your back arches
